note: Set A binds 25 rating claims to the correct circuit numbers and descriptions with no misreadings, including COOKTOP 50A, WATER HEATER 30A, INVERTER FEED 50A and MAIN BREAKER 150A; its only blemish is a duplicated DISHWASHER entry. Set B is largely accurate too and adds a few circuits A misses (HVAC FURNACE 1, CLOTHES WASHER 13, SHOWER LIGHT 25, DATA RACK 9), but it truncates the entity to 'MASTER BEDROOM R' with a truncated quote, gives an ambiguous 'SPARE' rating claim that cannot be bound to circuit 22 or 24, and spends four claims on trivial circuit-number/description attributes. Both sets omit several rows (e.g., CLOTHES DRYER 30A, LIVING ROOM RECEPTACLES, OUTDOOR RECEPTACLES), so coverage is comparable, but A's claims are uniformly correct and substantive while B mixes in vague and misread items.
